cases.assertion: Input/output nested-table mutation cannot alter the other owner.
Invalid reference or duplicate identity causes no MIR preflight writes.
An actual inherited research has intended settings, progression and physical effect.
Defaults, sentinels, profile round trips and meaningful boundaries retain behavior.
One approved broad collector retains effect coverage without per-family world scans.
Trigger/resource/independent science sources work; false outputs and unseeded cycles fail.
Cap below earned levels retains benefits; uncapping does not override foreign disablement.
Complete predecessor state survives upgrade and two independent cold reloads.
Handler reconstruction works on genuine joining/rejoining clients after host restart.
Global and foreign-write runtime contribution semantics remain correct.
First Library open/search has no deferred compiler stall; client views remain separate.
Required external consumer works without private imports and uses immediate late-stage call.
Optional consumer loads without MIR and behaves correctly with its capability.
Duplicate, unsupported and malformed input are bounded; runtime queries do not mutate.
Unrelated inputs leave exact-path work constant; actual output and broad work scale as declared.
Full-equivalent candidate has accepted repeated menu, memory, save/runtime and Library results.
Staged and canonical player member paths/bytes match for all applicable targets.
Original IDs and decisions migrate once, with local-only evidence preserved.
Repeated packages with identical declared build inputs have equal members; ZIP identity is conditional on the pinned container recipe.
Equal complete ordered inputs have equal native outputs and failure classes, without calling shared RNG.
Insertion permutations do not change set-semantics results; authored sequence and conflict rules remain explicit.
Save/reload and joining clients reconstruct handlers/state with deterministic tick-count scheduling, including backlog and force changes.
Same save and migration history produce the same transformation; idempotent reconciliation and exactly-once migration are tested separately.
Nonfinite values are rejected; zero/inherit/unlimited and formula evaluation/accumulation order preserve inherited semantics.
Changing language, display ordering or translation callback order does not alter force research/effect semantics.
Local forward prerequisites are accepted; duplicate or cyclic family is rejected before MIR writes; no deferred global registry.
Two independently named external consumers call the versioned public module, including after MIR final-fixes, without private imports.
Runtime query preserves native level semantics and returns bounded missing-state results without modifying game or storage.
Settings prototypes, effective startup values and per-user UI settings respect the stage and ownership boundary.
Reused receipts retain original inputs; changed save/settings/mod bytes invalidate affected coverage.
